reviewFlags.issue: The catalog says Japan. The only spec-table page found, for the ES-ED20-V520 variant, says China. No page confirms the origin of ES-ED20.
No Israeli importer or Israeli retailer page names ES-ED20. The Israeli variant and its voltage, plug and warranty are unclear. The only spec table found is for ES-ED20-V520, a different suffix.
The catalog's tweezer count (48), double-disc system, two speeds and Li-ion battery come from the V520 variant page, which says one speed. They are not confirmed for ES-ED20 itself.

The manufacturer manual is a 2014 print shared by four models (ES-ED90, ES-ED70, ES-ED50, ES-ED20). It may be dated, and the model may be discontinued. Warranty length also conflicts across sources (1 year and 3 years), so it is not recorded here.

No Israeli importer or Israeli retailer page names ES-ED20; the Israeli suffix and its plug and warranty are unconfirmed. Tweezer count and head angle come only from an Amazon.de page for ES-ED20-V503.
Catalog says Japan; a variant spec page reportedly says China. Not confirmed.

Catalog lists 2 speeds (Normal/Soft) and charging time of 60 minutes; manual confirms approx. 1 hour charging, but the SOFT mode is not confirmed for ES-ED20 and a variant page reportedly lists one speed.
Manufacturer manual is a 2014 print shared by four models; the model may be discontinued.
